lines.en: label day130:
Some time later...
scene bathmale1
Okay, so, before you ask: Yes, this is a bathhouse.
And no, I have not been here before.
Hell, I didn’t even realize Kumon-mi had a bathhouse until approximately half an hour ago when I found out our water had been shut off for some reason.
And given that it’s already the middle of the night and that the water company is closed, the four of us were left with no other option but to come here.
Yes, that’s right. I said four of us.
Maya and Ayane were planning on staying the night as well.
And before you go getting all excited about what this could possibly mean, allow me to break your heart.
This is not a co-ed bathhouse...meaning I need to bathe alone while the other three do whatever it is girls do when they’re in the bath together.
Which is probably bathe.
But the more exciting side of me likes to believe it’s something else.
I guess on one hand, though, it is kind of beneficial to be in here alone.
if amifingered == True:
Having both Ami and Ayane in the same bath as me might be problematic for a number of reasons.
Would I like to have that happen regardless of any potential issues that might arise? Absolutely.
But I guess being apart from them is the safer option after all.
else:
Having Ayane in the same bath as me might be a bit of an issue when it comes to hiding the, uhh, nature of our relationship from Ami and Maya.
Sure, I’m positive that they’re well aware of her feelings by now, but I doubt they’d want to be around when she attempts to capitalize on them.
scene black
scene bathmale2
I take my clothes off and move through the door to find an exceedingly large open-air bath.
And, as expected, there are no other men in sight.
This is a good thing.
Don’t get me wrong, I’m not afraid of other men or anything like that- I just prefer when the bath isn’t overcrowded with penises.
scene bathmale3
I step into the water and immediately sit down.
The hot summer air mixed with the heat of the bath is actually somewhat comforting, in a way.
You’d think that two different levels of extreme heat would be enough to exhaust you but, for some reason, that doesn’t seem to be the case.
I sigh to myself as my body temperature rises and am suddenly stricken with an idea that only the protagonist of an erotic game would have.
: I can hear the girls from here...
In addition to the lack of penises, the lack of noise creates a much easier atmosphere to eavesdrop in.
I hush my breathing and direct my full attention to what wonders must lie on the opposite side of this bamboo fence...
scene black
jump girlbathx
label girlbathx:
scene girlbath1
: ...And that’s how I found out I was allergic to Penicillin.
: Wait...weren’t we talking about reality shows? How did we wind up discussing your medicine allergy?
: Idunno. It just kind of happened, I guess. Does it really matter?
: Ami, why even bother asking Ayane something like that?
: Turning conversations into endless rants about weird stuff is kind of her specialty.
scene girlbath2
: Hey, wait a second! That’s not true! I have plenty of interesting things to say that aren’t random!
: Huh? I never said you didn’t.
: Maya kind of has a point, though. I feel like any time we wind up on a weird topic, you’re the one to blame.
scene girlbath3
: Well forgive me for having interesting thoughts and opinions!
: What does that have to do with a Penicillin allergy?...
: Everything, Maya. Everything.
: What’s the point of having friends if you can’t share every single thought you have with them?
scene girlbath4
: Uhh...I’m not sure I want to hear about every single thought you have, Ayane.
: I’ve heard the way you talk about my [uncle]...It’s not very...reserved.
: Ditto. Please at least wait until I have more clothes on to discuss anything about that man.
: Words alone are enough to make me feel gross about this entire situation.
scene girlbath5
: Of course it’s not reserved. Why would I need to be reserved about the man I’m in love with?
scene girlbath6
: Wait, love?! Who said anything about love?!
: I did, just now.
: Aren’t you a little too [young]to be in love?...
: Ami, don’t listen to her. Love knows no bounds, and I am in love with your [uncle].
: In fact, I have already talked with him and the two of us have decided to name our first child Ami, after you.
scene girlbath7
: How the heck is that supposed to make me feel better?! There are already more than enough Ami’s!
: There’s only one, though.
: Exactly! One is the limit! Name your baby Maya or something instead!
: As flattered as I am to hear that, I think you accidentally just agreed to her fostering your [uncle]’s child.
scene girlbath8
: Ami, I...I don’t know what to say...I never thought that you’d agree to this without a fight...
: In fact, all these years, I kind of had a feeling you might have liked-
: Wait a second! I never agreed to anything like that! And if you’re about to accuse me of what I think you’re about to accuse me of, I will drown you!
scene girlbath9
: Woah. You don’t normally get this defensive whenever I talk about this kind of stuff.
: Did something happen between you and Sensei?
scene girlbath10
: H-Happen? What would possibly happen between us? We’re family. Hahahah...
: Hmm...
scene girlbath11
: I guess you’re right. I don’t know about you, but Sensei would never stoop to doing unsavory things with someone he’s related to.
: That would be flat-out disgusting. Hahahah~
scene girlbath12
: Tch-!
if amifingered == True:
: Who are you calling disgusting, blondie?
: If it’s any consolation, I don’t think you’re disgusting, Ami.
: You stay out of this, Maya. This isn’t your fight.
: Understood.
else:
:  I wouldn’t be so annoyed if that wasn’t true.
scene girlbath13
: Listen, Ami. I’ll stop talking about my relationship with Sensei if it makes you happy, okay?
: I get that I can be a little obsessive sometimes, but I’ll try to tone it down if it means preserving our friendship.
scene girlbath14
: Wait, why are you suddenly being all nice? How am I supposed to be mad at you when you say things like that?
: I’m just being honest. My relationship with Sensei is something that you shouldn’t need to hear about.
scene girlbath15
: Umm, okay...but can you stop saying “My relationship with Sensei?”
: It makes it seem like something is actually going on between you two.
scene girlbath16
: Oh? Silly me~ I guess I’ll need to be more careful with my phrasing in the future.
scene girlbath17
: What did you do?
: Hm? What do you mean?
: What did you do, Ayane?
: You didn’t tell him how you feel, did you?
: Ami...This is your [uncle] we’re talking about...Do you really think I would do something like that?
: Yes. Now tell me what you did.
scene girlbath18
: I didn’t do anything that wouldn’t have eventually happened on its own~
scene girlbath19
: Maya.
: Huh? What?
: Will you call the police on me if I kill her?
: Uhh, I think I left my phone at your house.
: Good.
scene girlbath20
: Hey, hey, there’s no need to kill anybody. I really didn’t do anything. I promise.
: And even if I did, you’re the last person I would tell.
scene girlbath21
: Why is it that all of the things you say to cheer me up do the exact opposite?!
: Which ring in Hell do you reside in, demon?! And why must you steal the one thing I love?!
scene girlbath22
: I'd hate to interrupt this loving exchange between two best friends, but do either of you have any shampoo I can borrow?
: I just realized I’ve been washing my hair with only water for almost five minutes now.
scene girlbath21
: Okay. Never mind.
: Ami, I’m really not stealing anything, I promise.
: Even I know how crazy it is to imagine that Sensei would actually devote himself to someone like me.
scene girlbath23
: Well then stop saying such weird stuff all the time! I don’t like it.
: I know you like him but he’s still my [uncle]. Isn’t there supposed to be some kind of code that prevents you from making a move on him or something?
: Who said I’m going to make a move?
: I’m pretty sure you have like, eight hundred times by now.
: You literally told me you were gonna name your baby after me a few minutes ago.
: I was joking. And besides, you already said there is an Ami-limit, didn’t you?
: It wouldn’t be right of me to steal your [uncle] and your name. So if it’ll make you happy, I’ll stay away from both.
: Well...thank you Ay-
scene girlbath24
: There is one condition though.
: Huh?
: And I’ll stay quiet in case you don’t want Maya to hear.
: Um...it feels kind of weird whispering when she’s right there...but what do you want?
: It’s simple.
: I’ll stay away from Sensei if you tell me you like him too.
scene girlbath25
: What are you talking about? He’s my [uncle]...
: Of course I don’t like him that way...
: So the only reason you feel weird about me liking him is because you guys are related? Not because you don’t want to be my love-rival?
: Uh-huh...
: Good! Then I guess this calls for a celebratory hug then, doesn’t it?
scene girlbath26
: Wait, what? We’re both na-
scene girlbath27
: AHHH! GET OFF OF ME! YOU’RE ALL WET!
: So are you, idiot! We’re in the bath!
: AYANEEEE! STOP!
: Those two have a weird relationship.
scene black
scene bathmale3
: Ugh...Well, that sucks.
I wound up not being able to hear much of anything until Ami started screaming a few seconds ago.
Oh well.
I guess it wouldn’t be fair for me to hear everything the three of them talked about.
Some things are better left as a mystery I guess.
But regardless, this was definitely relaxing.
Maybe I’ll come back here sometime.
scene black
With or without the girls...
But preferably with.
$ day130 = True
